about.title: A bench, not a counter.
about.lead: FixArt is a small studio in Prague 3, Žižkov. We fix iPhone, Mac, Samsung, Xiaomi, Pixel and Huawei — without a mall-shop markup.
about.body: Artem Mikhailov diagnoses and repairs the device himself. The price holds before the first screw and usually sits about 30% under Prague's priciest shops for the same job. Studio at Biskupcova 31, two minutes from the Biskupcova tram stop.
about.item3: Up to 12-month warranty on labour and part
about.item4: We don't touch your data unless the repair needs it

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Do you repair iPhones with a locked Apple ID?
faq.a1: Hardware, yes. We don't unlock Apple ID and we won't bypass it.
faq.a2: We say it straight: original, OEM, or a tested compatible. You choose before work, and the price follows the part.
faq.a3: Batteries and glass often the same day. Boards and ordered parts take days — not weeks of silence.
faq.a4: An unauthorised repair usually ends it on Apple. We say that out loud before we start.
faq.a5: No. Still make a backup. We don't browse the phone.
faq.q6: Can I send it by courier?
faq.a6: Yes. Write on Telegram @liltrafficRUS. Studio address: Biskupcova 31, Prague 3.
faq.q7: Why are you cheaper than the big shops?
faq.a7: No mall rent, no counter handoff, no chain of technicians. One bench, one price before the first screw. Our top end sits about 30% under premium original quotes in Prague.
